[EN] [Dungeon - 473] Bahaar’s Sanctum
[ES] [Mazmorra - 473] Bahaar’s Sanctum
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use Seir's Order to go to Firebase Intrepid. [Press to open your inventory and right-click the Order: Fyrmount Support to teleport to Firebase Intrepid.]
[ES] Usa la orden de Seir para ir a Firebase Intrepid. [Presiona para abrir tu inventario y haz clic derecho en la Orden: Apoyo de Fyrmount para teletransportarte a Firebase Intrepid.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Firebase Intrepid
[ES] Firebase Intrepid
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] So much is happening...with all the Toxic Gas...so many wounded...
[ES] Están pasando tantas cosas... con todo el gas tóxico... tantos heridos...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask {@linkcreature:204#1003#Kimuk} at Firebase Intrepid where Sophilia is.
[ES] Pregúntale a {@linkcreature:204#1003#Kimuk} en Firebase Intrepid dónde está Sophilia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask {@linkcreature:204#1003#Kimuk} at Firebase Intrepid where Sophilia is.
[ES] Pregúntale a {@linkcreature:204#1003#Kimuk} en Firebase Intrepid dónde está Sophilia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Sophilia's Location
[ES] Ubicación de Sophilia
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Blazing Vale where {@LinkCreature:4#904401#Sophilia} is rescuing civilians.
[ES] Ve a Blazing Vale donde {@LinkCreature:4#904401#Sophilia} está rescatando civiles.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Tell Sophilia that you came to help.
[ES] Dile a Sophilia que viniste a ayudar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll be there."
[ES] "Estaré allí."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Listen to Loomey's explanation of the phenomenon.
[ES] Escucha la explicación de Loomey sobre el fenómeno.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll handle it."
[ES] "Yo me encargo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Sophilia.
[ES] Habla con Sophilia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Sounds like...fun?"
[ES] "¿Suena como... diversión?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with {@LinkCreature:4#904403#Loomey} just outside Firebase Valor.
[ES] Habla con {@LinkCreature:4#904403#Loomey} justo afuera de Firebase Valor.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the Talisman and break the link between the {@LinkObject:44401#Enlarged Smoldering Bloodshard} and the volcano.
[ES] Usa el talismán y rompe el vínculo entre {@LinkObject:44401#Enlarged Smoldering Bloodshard} y el volcán.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "What source of power?"
[ES] "¿Qué fuente de poder?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Tell Loomey what happened.
[ES] Cuéntale a Loomey lo que pasó.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Enlarged Smoldering Bloodshard Location
[ES] Ubicación de Enlarged Smoldering Bloodshard
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Loomey seems dumbstruck and devastated, staring at Bahaar's Maw.
[ES] Loomey parece atónito y devastado, mirando fijamente a Bahaar's Maw.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go after {@LinkCreature:4#904404#Loomey}.
[ES] Ve tras {@LinkCreature:4#904404#Loomey}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm listening."
[ES] "Te estoy escuchando."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Loomey.
[ES] Habla con Loomey.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm already on my way."
[ES] "Ya voy en camino."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Halrath.
[ES] Habla con Halrath.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bahaar's Sanctum Entrance
[ES] Entrada al Sagrario de Bahaar
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Bahaar's Sanctum Entrance at Fyrmount. [You must have a flying mount to go to Bahaar's Sanctum Entrance.]
[ES] Ve a la Entrada al Sagrario de Bahaar en Fyrmount. [Debes tener una montura voladora para ir a la Entrada al Sagrario de Bahaar.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm ready to go inside."
[ES] "Estoy listo para entrar."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Halrath at Bahaar's Sanctum Entrance.
[ES] Habla con Halrath en la Entrada al Sagrario de Bahaar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bahaar's Sanctum
[ES] Sagrario de Bahaar
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Someone...or something...must have broken in.
[ES] Alguien... o algo... debe haber forzado la entrada.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the {@LinkCreature:4#9044#teleportal} to enter Bahaar's Sanctum.
[ES] Usa el {@LinkCreature:4#9044#teleportal} para entrar al Sagrario de Bahaar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Halrath...what's going on?"
[ES] "Halrath... ¿qué está pasando?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Investigate the broken seal.
[ES] Investiga el sello roto.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll hold him as long as possible."
[ES] "Lo retendré todo el tiempo posible."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Halrath.
[ES] Habla con Halrath.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Enter Bahaar's Sanctum and defeat Bahaar.
[ES] Entra al Sagrario de Bahaar y derrota a Bahaar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Glad to be of service."
[ES] Encantado de servir.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Tell Halrath that you've defeated Bahaar.
[ES] Dile a Halrath que has derrotado a Bahaar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
